what: Idle output of a live agy pane, read from CAO's pipe-pane log while the seat sat at its ready prompt (no input sent, nothing written to the pane).
pane_state: idle at the ready footer; the CAO status API read 'idle' before and after the recording
method: A read-only poll of the terminal log file every 50 ms, stamping each read with a monotonic clock. The file was opened for reading only and nothing was attached to the pane.
scrub: None needed: every read was this one 39-byte chunk of terminal-mode sequences, with no text, no path and no identity.
